Stream4 briefing · MD Copy Stream 4: Briefing Overview Stream 4 is an exhaustive, interactive exploration of three leading consumer web AI platforms. The project subjects each system to a rigorous, hands-on testing regimen — moving well beyond surface-level prompting to probe the edges of reasoning, creativity, instruction-following, and real-world utility. Scope Three consumer-facing AI assistants are evaluated side by side across a broad spectrum of tasks. Each platform is engaged interactively, with responses feeding back into subsequent prompts to simulate genuine, extended use rather than isolated snapshot testing. Methodology Sessions are structured to stress-test each AI across core competencies: Reasoning & logic — multi-step problems, edge cases, and contradiction detection Creative output — long-form writing, ideation, and stylistic range Instruction fidelity — precision, constraint-following, and format adherence Conversational depth — coherence across extended, branching dialogues Goals Stream 4 aims to produce an honest, comparative picture of where consumer AI currently stands — what each platform does well, where it stumbles, and how the three differ in character and capability. Audience Researchers, enthusiasts, and practitioners seeking a ground-level, unfiltered account of the current consumer AI landscape. Share
